verdict.rationale: Postmark documents registrable outbound webhooks for real-time event notifications, with dedicated Delivery and Bounce webhook pages, guidance on protecting the webhook, and an idempotency pattern for handlers. The pack shows no spam-complaint webhook and no documented retry schedule, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of a complaint/spam-complaint webhook, documented webhook retry behavior (schedule, attempts, backoff), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can receive webhooks for delivered, bounced, and complained events with documented retry behavior, so my app reacts to email outcomes in real time

citations.quote: payload shape validation, event parsing, Express route setup, and idempotency pattern
